own_reveal_uv.note: Own metric depth UV, zero degenerate export UV. Photo inner divisions are still photographic, not fully modelled.

entrance_steps_reviewed.note: BothD1/D2 threshold dimensions match registered lower edge; solid underfill instead of floating slab. Number of historic steps undetermined, no261 staircase copied; terrain grade provisional.

base_coplanar_flicker.note: Offset base below walls, no overlapping parallel planes at threshold. Static and alternate camera review, not video performance claim.

no_duplicate_geometry_in_albedo.note: No downpipes modelled because source does not establish them. Hypothetical gutter lies above the cropped albedo, no photo pipe erased. Source-backed sill/cornice fronts align to their original face strips; rear photo hidden by actual foreground geometry.

dormer_and_arch.note: No dormer convincingly documented in chosen photographed fragment. Earlier proposed roof light does not prove photographed state.

roof_and_chimneys.note: Chimneys now intersect roof; roof planes closed. Exact ridge/hip extent and roof phase not established because right edge truncated.

colour_resolution.note: Front1536x1200 derives from small image and cannot add historical detail. Large hidden walls use calibrated unique albedo. Ochre/slate hues provisional contrary to earliercream/red assignment; no DB rewrite.

bevel_C.note: Selected exposed frame/sill/cornice/threshold edges8mm,3segments; no subdivision. Major shell corners remain straight.

lettering_damage.note: No readable facade text; photographic visible patina retained. Earlier colourization occlusion fill not asserted exact original damage.

identity_source_click.note: Actual source dialog click, card259label and both construction sheets reviewed. House label distinguished from full parcel boundary.

historical_geometry.note: Four-axis1871plan differs from five-axis photographed fragment, exact correspondence and right extent unresolved. Do not propagate into street.
